title: Metadata
description: Cross-cutting metadata for traceability, auditing, and integration context.

correlationId.description: End-to-end correlation identifier for distributed tracing.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the originating API request.

sourceSystem.description: System or application that originated the payload.

sourceEnvironment.description: Environment of the source system (e.g. production, staging).

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the resource was created.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the resource was last updated.

tags.description: Optional key-value or label tags for classification.

attributes.description: Arbitrary string attributes for integration-specific metadata.
